title: Yellowed Malaysian Almond Biryani
description: A salty, aerated, and cozy Malaysian dish featuring ground almonds, this biryani is a unique twist on traditional recipes, dehydrated to perfection and ayurvedic-rajasic-friendly.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large pan, heat the ghee over medium heat and saute the onion until it is translucent.
Add the garlic and cook for an additional minute, stirring constantly.
In a separate pot, bring 4 cups of water to a boil and add the basmati rice, cooking until it is 75% done.
In a large bowl, combine the cooked rice, ground almonds, turmeric, salt, and black pepper, mixing well.
Add the sauteed onion and garlic to the rice mixture and stir to combine.
Transfer the mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish and dehydrate in the oven for 30 minutes.
Remove the biryani from the oven and let it cool for 10 minutes before serving.
